        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateContent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DesignVisuals</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectChannels</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_LaunchCampaign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TrackPerformance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AnalyzePerformance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Completed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CRM" name="CRM System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectLeads</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Sales" name="Sales Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FollowUpLeads</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <!-- Start -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Start Process"/>

    <!-- Tasks -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DefineObjectives" name="Define marketing campaign objectives"/>
    <!-- Parallel split for three preparation activities -->
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Split" name="Preparation Parallel Split"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateContent" name="Create content"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DesignVisuals" name="Design visuals"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectChannels" name="Select promotion channels"/>
    <!-- Parallel join -->
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Join" name="Preparation Parallel Join"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LaunchCampaign" name="Launch campaign"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TrackPerformance" name="Track performance in real‑time"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectLeads" name="Collect leads in CRM system"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FollowUpLeads" name="Follow up leads"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AnalyzePerformance" name="Analyze performance for future optimization"/>

    <!-- End -->
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Completed" name="Process Completed"/>

    <!-- Sequence Flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_start_to_define" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_DefineObjectives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_define_to_split" sourceRef="Task_DefineObjectives" targetRef="Gateway_Split"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_split_to_content" sourceRef="Gateway_Split" targetRef="Task_CreateContent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_split_to_design" sourceRef="Gateway_Split" targetRef="Task_DesignVisuals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_split_to_channels" sourceRef="Gateway_Split" targetRef="Task_SelectChannels"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_content_to_join" sourceRef="Task_CreateContent" targetRef="Gateway_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_design_to_join" sourceRef="Task_DesignVisuals" targetRef="Gateway_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_channels_to_join" sourceRef="Task_SelectChannels" targetRef="Gateway_Join"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_join_to_launch" sourceRef="Gateway_Join" targetRef="Task_LaunchCampaign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_launch_to_track" sourceRef="Task_LaunchCampaign" targetRef="Task_TrackPerformance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_track_to_collect" sourceRef="Task_TrackPerformance" targetRef="Task_CollectLeads"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_collect_to_followup" sourceRef="Task_CollectLeads" targetRef="Task_FollowUpLeads"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_followup_to_analyze" sourceRef="Task_FollowUpLeads" targetRef="Task_AnalyzePerformance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_analyze_to_end" sourceRef="Task_AnalyzePerformance" targetRef="EndEvent_Completed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
